newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close lower amid uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close lower amid uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Sunday, with investors unsure whether the new government could implement its reform programme, dealers said.
New finance chief Shahid Javed Burki on Saturday laid out a sweeping reform programme to shore up Pakistan's finances and regain the favour of the IMF and World Bank.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index plunged 24.60 points, or 1.62 percent, to end at 1,492.27. Losers led gainers 169 to 49. Turnover fell to 56.25 million shares from 66.97 million in the previous session.

Faysal Bank fell 1.60 rupees to 23.50 rupees and Bank of Punjab 1.25 to 17.75. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.40 to 37.60. D.G. Khan Cement fell 1.0 to 10.25. Hub Power Co fell 0.85 to 34.60 and Pakistan State Oil 9.0 to 385.
PTCL rose 0.50 to 32.30. ICI Pakistan fell 0.75 to 19.75, Fauji Fertilizer 1.25 to 82 and Engro Chemical 3.0 to 142.
